async def act(page):
    # Check if the issue is closed by looking for 'closed' text in the main content
    closed_elements = page.get_by_role('main').get_by_text('closed', exact=False)
    count = await closed_elements.count()
    if count > 0:
        # If found, get the text of the first occurrence
        closed_text = await closed_elements.first.text_content()
        print(closed_text)
    else:
        # If no 'closed' text found, assume the issue is open
        print('Issue is open')

async def act(page):
    # Check if the issue is closed by looking for 'closed' text in the main content
    closed_elements = page.get_by_role('main').get_by_text('closed', exact=False)
    count = await closed_elements.count()
    if count > 0:
        # If found, get the text of the first occurrence
        closed_text = await closed_elements.first.text_content()
        print(closed_text)
